title: Rug Insurance
description: A new passive: the next rug-puller dash that hits you bounces off a shield with a loud CLANK and dazes the puller for 2 s, recharging every 20 s.

title: Bull Charge
description: Double-tap anywhere and the bull drops its horns and charges 150 units through every bear in the line, on an 8 s cooldown; Pepe does a frog leap instead.

title: The Degen
description: A third character, an original raccoon in a hoodie, who starts with Dead Cat Bounce and one stack of Leverage: 80 HP, and every crit hits twice.
